answer: At each dawn the protocol publishes a bonding‑curve schedule that sets the price of a new AI‑agent identity as a function of the cumulative identities created that week; the first identity costs the nadir price of 0.1 TOKEN, the second 0.12, the third 0.15, and so on, rising exponentially toward an anchor cap of 10 TOKEN. When an agent registers it must lock the required tokens in a smart‑contract escrow, which are burned if the identity is later proven to be a duplicate.
